text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 4, "unit": "friends", "kind": "count", "span": "Jerome had 4 friends"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 20, "unit": "times", "kind": "count", "span": "pressed on the doorbell 20 times"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 1, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "1/4 times more than ... first friend"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "1/4 times more than ... first friend"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 10, "unit": "times", "kind": "count", "span": "10 times more than the fourth friend"}, {"id": "q6", "value": 60, "unit": "times", "kind": "count", "span": "the fourth friend pressed ... 60 times"}], "plan": [{"op": "div", "args": ["q3", "q4"], "out": "s1", "note": "the extra quarter: 1/4"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "a quarter more than the first friend's 20 presses"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q2", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "the second friend's presses"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q6", "q5"], "out": "s4", "note": "the third friend pressed 10 more than the fourth's 60"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q2", "s3"], "out": "s5", "note": "first friend plus second friend"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s5", "s4"], "out": "s6", "note": "plus the third friend"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s6", "q6"], "out": "s7", "note": "plus the fourth friend"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many doorbell rings the doorbell made in all"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 4, "reason": "'4 friends' is a headcount; each friend's presses are added individually"}, {"value": 0.3333333333333333, "reason": "'the third friend' is an ordinal label, not one third of anything"}]}
